evidence.title: KatFishNet: Detecting LLM-Generated Korean Text through Linguistic Feature Analysis
supports: Korean spacing, POS diversity, and comma usage can expose domain-dependent distributional differences.
Korean-specific signals should not be replaced by English-only heuristics.
limitations: The task is authorship detection, not writing-quality evaluation.
Signals vary by genre and must not become unconditional lint failures.
The linked research repository did not declare a machine-readable license when reviewed.
evidence.artifact_license: paper CC-BY-4.0; linked code/data not vendored

evidence.title: StyleKQC: A Style-Variant Paraphrase Corpus for Korean Questions and Commands
supports: Korean directive rewriting must preserve core intent while controlling formality.
Style conversion is task- and speech-act-dependent.
limitations: The corpus focuses on questions and commands in six daily-life topics.
The linked dataset repository did not declare a machine-readable license when reviewed.
evidence.artifact_license: paper CC-BY-4.0; linked data not vendored

evidence.title: Kosmic: Korean Text Similarity Metric Reflecting Honorific Distinctions
supports: Semantic similarity alone misses Korean honorific and tone differences.
Meaning and register should be evaluated as separate dimensions.
limitations: The benchmark has 1,000 annotated pairs and does not cover every channel or organization.

evidence.title: Revisiting the Concept of Translationese based on Corpus Analysis
supports: Expressions called translationese can also occur in non-translated Korean.
Translationese labels require contextual and corpus-based interpretation.
limitations: The study analyzes two English prepositions in Korean news-magazine corpora.

evidence.title: Translationese Features as Indicators of Quality in English-Russian Human Translation
supports: Translatedness signals are not automatically writing-quality signals.
Authorship or provenance classification must be separated from quality evaluation.
limitations: The language pair is English-Russian, so the finding is used as a methodological warning, not a Korean threshold.
evidence.artifact_license: paper ACL Anthology terms; no artifacts vendored

evidence.title: TRUE: Re-evaluating Factual Consistency Evaluation
supports: Factual consistency metrics need example-level evaluation across tasks.
NLI and QA-based approaches provide complementary semantic signals.
limitations: The evaluated datasets are not a Korean rewriting benchmark.
Model-based evaluators remain optional until Korean calibration is complete.

evidence.title: Localizing Factual Inconsistencies in Attributable Text Generation
supports: Consistency errors should be localized to small predicate-argument claims.
A single opaque semantic score is less actionable than localized evidence.
limitations: The automatic methods require model evaluation beyond the deterministic core.

evidence.title: Benchmarking Linguistic Diversity of Large Language Models
supports: Lexical, syntactic, and semantic diversity are distinct dimensions.
Diversity is best evaluated over a corpus or batch, not inferred from one short text.
limitations: The experiments focus on story generation and are not Korean-specific.

evidence.title: Judging the Judges: A Systematic Study of Position Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge
supports: LLM judges exhibit systematic position bias that varies by judge and task.
Judge outputs require repetition, position-swap, and human calibration checks.
limitations: The benchmark is not specific to Korean style evaluation.

evidence.title: XDAC: XAI-Driven Detection and Attribution of LLM-Generated News Comments in Korean
supports: Short-form Korean needs domain-specific token and character signals.
Explanations should attribute which local signals affected a result.
limitations: The task is news-comment authorship detection, not output quality.
Reported detection performance must not be reused as a HangeuLint claim.

evidence.title: Unsupervised Detection of LLM-Generated Text in Korean Using Syntactic and Semantic Cues
supports: Korean generated-text signals can combine syntactic and semantic layers.
Evaluation must cover multiple domains and model families.
limitations: The task is authorship detection, not naturalness or task fitness.
The linked repository did not declare a machine-readable license when reviewed.

evidence.title: A Testset for Context-Aware LLM Translation in Korean-to-English Discourse Level Translation
supports: Lexical ambiguity, zero anaphora, slang, idiom, figurative language, and implicature require discourse context.
Sentence-only evaluation cannot cover all pragmatic meaning changes.
limitations: The translation direction is Korean-to-English, not Korean rewriting.

evidence.title: Kiwipiepy: Python API for Kiwi
supports: Optional Korean morphological tokenization and POS telemetry.
limitations: Optional dependency only; its outputs are not calibrated quality thresholds.
The library is not bundled with HangeuLint Core.

evidence.title: HangeuLint clean-room starter heuristics
supports: Starter rules provide explainable regression checks for known Korean editing failures.
limitations: Fixtures are hand-authored regression cases, not a representative benchmark.
No accuracy or AI-authorship claim may be made from these fixtures.
